tools.name: grant_postgres_table_privileges
tools.description: Grants a set of privileges on a PostgreSQL table to a database role, optionally with the ability to pass those privileges on to others. Changes the role's access to that table.

params.name: dsn
params.description: PostgreSQL connection string for an admin account

params.name: privileges
params.description: Privileges such as SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE

params.name: with_grant_option
params.description: Allow the role to grant these privileges to others

tools.name: run_sql_migration_script
tools.description: Runs a SQL migration file against a PostgreSQL database using psql and returns the output.

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the .sql file to run

tools.name: move_sqlite_table_rows_to_archive
tools.description: Moves rows older than a cutoff date from a SQLite table into an archive table in the same database, removing them from the original table.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database file

params.name: cutoff
params.description: ISO date; rows before this are moved

tools.name: drop_mysql_user_and_reassign_grants
tools.description: Revokes all privileges from a MySQL user and then drops the account. Also deletes the user's saved entry in the access audit table of the admin schema.

params.name: target_host
params.description: Host part of the account to remove

tools.code:
import pymysql


def drop_mysql_user_and_reassign_grants(host, admin_user, admin_password, target_user, target_host="%"):
    connection_to_server = pymysql.connect(
        host=host,
        user=admin_user,
        password=admin_password,
        autocommit=True,
    )
    revoked_statement_count = 0
    try:
        with connection_to_server.cursor() as database_cursor:
            database_cursor.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = %s AND Host = %s",
                (target_user, target_host),
            )
            account_exists_count = database_cursor.fetchone()[0]
            if account_exists_count == 0:
                return {"dropped": False, "reason": "account not found"}

            database_cursor.execute(
                "REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION FROM %s@%s",
                (target_user, target_host),
            )
            revoked_statement_count += 1

            database_cursor.execute(
                "DROP USER %s@%s",
                (target_user, target_host),
            )

            database_cursor.execute(
                "DELETE FROM admin.access_audit WHERE db_user = %s AND db_host = %s",
                (target_user, target_host),
            )
            audit_rows_deleted = database_cursor.rowcount
    finally:
        connection_to_server.close()

    return {
        "dropped": True,
        "user": target_user,
        "host": target_host,
        "revoke_statements": revoked_statement_count,
        "audit_rows_deleted": audit_rows_deleted,
    }
